findings.state_law: Gov. Code § 66315: no owner-occupancy requirement may be imposed on ADUs (narrow exception: separate-conveyance sales under § 66341(c)(3)). JADUs with shared sanitation are a lawful exception (§ 66333(b)).
findings.hcd_precedent: HCD letter to City of Laguna Beach, Sept. 19, 2024 (owner-occupancy imposed on SB 9 developments, not allowed); HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026), Owner-Occupancy.
